raw.scene_notes: No clear FOD found. Tiles 0 and 1 show distant taxiway and airfield, buildings and the aircraft tail, with no loose debris nearby. Tile 2 shows a fuel truck, a person and a wheel/tyre at the truck, which I treated as ground equipment and not FOD. Tile 3 shows the nose of the aircraft, the jet bridge, an orange cable (GPU or air hose, connected to the aircraft) and small bright patches on the dark apron at the bottom right, which look like wet or frost reflections, not objects. Lighting is dark and low-contrast, so very small items could be missed.

No clear FOD found on the apron in any of the four tiles. The orange cones, ground equipment, tug, baggage carts, people and painted markings are not FOD. Dark patches on the pavement look like stains or puddles. Small puddle-like marks near the cone in tile 0 and a small white item in the hand of the worker in tile 3 were not reported.
